Zone.title: Zone
Zone.description: A custom radio channel set/zone with repeater offset configuration and RX/TX safety profile.

name.description: Zone display name (e.g., Plymouth County Police, Plymouth County Fire).

category.description: Service category (Law Enforcement, Fire / EMS, Amateur / Repeater, NOAA / Marine, FRS / GMRS / MURS, Custom).

safetyProfile.description: Transmit safety profile applied when programming radios.

targetRadioModel.description: Target radio model profile (e.g., Baofeng UV-5R Mini, Quansheng UV-K5).

shareCode.description: Optional remote share code linked to /shared_codeplugs/{shareCode}.

version.description: Codeplug revision number for remote sync tracking.

channelSpecs.description: Bounded list (<= 100) of pipe-delimited channel specification records.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SharedCodeplug.title: SharedCodeplug
SharedCodeplug.description: A remotely shareable radio codeplug configuration identified by shareCode so field operators can pull or sync remote updates.

authorCallsign.description: Callsign or unit identifier of the publisher (non-PII).

shareCode.description: Unique alphanumeric share code matching the document ID.

safetyProfile.description: Safety profile enforced by this shared codeplug.

version.description: Version counter incremented on remote codeplug updates.

releaseNotes.description: Notes describing frequency or tone changes in this update.

channelSpecs.description: Bounded list (<= 100) of pipe-delimited channel specification records.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest remote push (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/zones/{zoneId}.description: User-owned custom channel sets and regional scanner/responder zones.

/shared_codeplugs/{shareCode}.description: Remotely shared codeplugs accessible by shareCode for over-the-air codeplug updates.
